entities.summary: Leon Boyd is a Dutch-Canadian former professional baseball pitcher. He pitched for the Netherlands national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2009 and 2013 World Baseball Classic. He pitched in Minor League Baseball in 2009 and also pitched several years in the Dutch Honkbal Hoofdklasse.
